messages:
olivia-logistics: FYI incoming H100 wave stuck at last-mile dock, carrier reports network backpressure at FRA hub, manifests failing validation. pictures + manifest attached. need decision on hold vs split-air.
vendor-forwarder: Sorry — we hit a broker queue at FRA, sorting now. The EDI feed kept timing out, hence the manifest rejection. ETA bump 18-24h. tracking: AWB 987-6543210
olivia-logistics: @vendor-forwarder can you confirm if customs docs are complete? last time missing HS code triggered extra hold.
vendor-forwarder: HS codes present, but local port flagged thermal inspection for 8 units (random sample). they're asking for depot photos and serials.
chris-procurement: If inspection leads to longhold we should evaluate an air-split for the critical 10 units. what's incremental cost to air-express for 10 H100s? need estimate to triage with finance.
vendor-forwarder: rough quote: +€95k for 10 units OTM air next-day FRA->LHR, including uplift and brokerage. can do AWB split but need go-ahead by EOW.
anna-ops: Are those 10 units reserved for any active Dedicated pools? Jamal, does this impact cluster capacity if we lose those for 48h?
jamal-sre: Yes — those are earmarked for two burst pools in EU-west. Losing 10 for 48h will raise queue latency ~35% during peak. We have fallback on smaller models but customer SLOs might degrade.
olivia-logistics: @chris-procurement we also need vendor confirmation on RMA coverage if units fail thermal post-inspection. vendor said depot-inspected units are still covered under DOA warranty, but vendor must sign carrier photo manifest.
vendor-forwarder: Confirmed — depot photos + signed manifest suffice for RMA initiation. If units fail inspection, we'll issue RMA-8472 and coordinate pickup within 48h.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-8472, linked AWB 987-6543210. Status: awaiting depot photos.
olivia-logistics: uploading photo set and serial list now. snippet:
```
serials: [H100-AB1234, H100-AB1235, H100-AB1236, H100-AB1237, H100-AB1238, H100-AB1239, H100-AB1240, H100-AB1241, H100-AB1242, H100-AB1243]
```
anna-ops: Quick ask: if we air-split, can vendor guarantee same warranty flow? we don't want duplicate RMA for split shipments.
vendor-forwarder: Yes — warranty follows unit serials, not AWB. We'll attach same RMA-8472 to split AWBs.
chris-procurement: I'll run the cost approval for +€95k. If finance declines, propose we accept 24h hold and trigger canary scaling (Jamal) to soften impact.
jamal-sre: Canary scaling ready. I'll pre-warm smaller instance types and bump autoscale thresholds. If hold extends >36h, need air-split.
olivia-logistics: Requesting vendor to confirm SLA: if manifest failure due to their EDI feed causes >24h delay, can we get credit note for expedited uplift? past precedence suggests partial waiver.
vendor-forwarder: Noted. We'll escalate to ops and request surcharge waiver if root cause on our side. Can't promise but we'll push. I will update in ~2h.
anna-ops: Also flag legal: need signed statement that depot photo evidence is official for insurance and warranty. Put that in the RMA notes.
olivia-logistics: Added note in RMA-8472 comment thread.
jamal-sre: From infra side, putting a soft-fallback: route non-critical inference to US-hosted pool until capacity normalizes. ETA for policy flip is 15m.
olivia-logistics: Thanks. @vendor-forwarder please prioritize photos + manifest sign-off, or advise by 18:00 CET if we should proceed with air-split. :thumbsup:
vendor-forwarder: Understood. Escalating now. Will ping back by 17:30 CET or earlier.
chris-procurement: If vendor confirms surcharge waiver, procurement approves air-split. Otherwise finance sign-off needed.
olivia-logistics: Closing loop — I'll post updates here. attaching photo links and courier thread (internal) for audit.
vendor-forwarder: Update: ops confirmed EDI outage on their partner network, they accepted responsibility and opened surcharge dispute. they estimate sign-off for waiver in ~3h.
olivia-logistics: Good news. Keeping hold for now. If waiver denied, revert to air-split plan. thanks everyone.
